High-level wrapper around ImpellerPaint. Paints control how draw calls encoded in a display list are rendered.

Imports

bindings/impeller_api

Types

Paint = object
  handle*: ImpellerPaint
RAII wrapper around ImpellerPaint. Released automatically.
